104010.t: After spending a day in Panoticon following the bunny girl commotion...
Tofu Street

Ugh, I'm so stiff...
Why is my body still this sore?

Hehe, that's only natural!
You did run around quite a bit at the casino, after all!

Even if I don't get hurt, I still get sore muscles...
What a strange body.

Really?
Maybe you're just too weak, Big Boss?
Shut up.

More importantly, why were we the only ones locked up?
Where did that trio of idiot vault thieves go?
I suspect their crime was so pathetic that the authorities did not even bother to arrest them.
Alternatively, they may have used some kind of perception-disrupting technology that makes it difficult to remember people's faces.
Yet another bizarre technology...

By the way, I remember their faces perfectly.
Don't you guys remember?
I paid them no attention, so I don't remember them very well.

Do we even need to care about that?
Big Boss will take care of it anyway!
That's true. Remembering too many faces is tiring too!
By the way, I guess we really shouldn't believe all the rumors...

To think they were the [Super Rich]...
I thought they were master thieves who only targeted high-security places...
Why do you sound so disappointed?
Well, because I was hoping to ask them to steal a pair of designer panties from a brand I've always dreamed of owning someday...
I guess if I really need a thief, I should look for [Carmento]...
Yeah, my bad for asking.

More importantly, what about Claire?
She's the one who ripped the vault door open.
According to the records, she ripped it open at M.A.D.'s instigation.
The fact that the Chronoscholar Family is a prestigious family in Vermont was probably also taken into consideration.
Tsk... *Sigh* So this time, we really did end up flat broke.
Maybe I should've pocketed some emergency cash from Yuria's commission...
How does it make any sense that all we got out of this was some weird USB drive with absolutely nothing on it?!

Come on, I still had a blast this time!
If every day is this fun, I'm completely satisfied!
Besides, Big Boss, didn't you get some pretty good use out of that data drive the other day?

What was it in Vermont... Kinogarten?
You were downloading movies from there and stuff...

Wh-What are you talking about...
I never did that...

Huh, really?
Hmm, I'm pretty sure I saw you watching some flesh-toned video with a Day of Freedom theme...

And you never let it leave your side for even a second.
Almost like you didn't want us to see it.

M-More importantly, there's a bigger point here!
You know, that we can live happily even without money!

That is correct.
You can still have fun even without money, and bread sampling is indeed possible without money.
Let's go line up early for the bread sampling together, .
Hmm... then what role will you play, ...?

Ah!
Could it be... stripping to distract people...?

I told you I'm not an exhibitionist!!
You can do all the flashing yourself!!
My, so rough!♡
Sigh, I'm so used to the antics of you two that I don't even feel like calling you out anymore.
Hehe, I'm glad you're adapting so quickly!
You've probably been overwhelmed ever since you fell from the sky, so I'm glad to see you're adjusting!

Humans are adaptable creatures.
No matter how physically weak they are, this much is well within their capabilities.
I had faith in you, .
Yeah, thanks, guys.
Heheh, to celebrate us all getting closer, and our first proper release from Panoticon together...
Should we take a commemorative photo?!
What?
Come on, this is nice too, Big Boss!
It's not like tofu is flying at our faces right this second!
If you say that, I feel like one really will fly at us, so could you please stop?

Heheh...
Then take one of us first!
And then we can grab anyone walking by and take one all together!!
Over here, over here!
Make sure you get Panoticon in the shot too! Snap a good one!
Ahaha, it has been a while since we took a picture together like this!
We have never taken a group mugshot, after all.

More importantly, Freya.
It is difficult to stand close because of your breasts.
Lumina is having a hard time standing close because of her breasts too!
Can't you just sort of rest your head on them?

...Hmm.
Squishy...

Doing enviable things again... I'm taking it now, okay?
One, two, cheese—

Wh-What is it?!
What's happening all of a sudden?!
Oh my... That was quite a noise behind us...

Typical Humanitas.
I did think it was unusually quiet today.

Is this really the time to stand around admiring it?!
Hurry up and get out of the way before the debris falls—!!!
Humanitas Alley
*Huff*... *huff*... I ended up running again, even though I'm really not cut out for this...

What on earth??
Did someone plant a bomb in the Panoticon??
There is no reason to blow up a place where one only needs to rest for about a day before leaving.
Perhaps a gas accident occurred.

Exactly.
The food is great and the service is good, so why on earth would anyone carry out a bomb attack?

Hmm...
But the explosion seemed to come from the detention floor...
Hey, it's still a prison, so there might be one or two bad things about it.

I mean, you do lose some of your freedom, right?
I guess someone could have a complaint or two...
... everyone

...Now that I think about it, all I can think of are benefits that more than make up for that.
In that case, it must be—
As expected, whaaat?

Wh-Whoa!?
It suddenly got dar—
Ahahahaha! Kidnapping complete!

Ugh, the smell of booze!
Who is this?!
Eheheheh, don't be so cold to someone in the same line of work!

We even ate food together in the Panoticon...
and talked, didn't we?

Eh?
...Did we?

Hey!! Mane!!
What do you think you're doing, kidnapping our Big Boss like that?!
Give him back right now?!!

Ahh, right...
There was one speedy little thing, wasn't there?
Okaaay, you can have a beer too!

Aaaah!!!
I slipped on the beer can!!!
What the hell?! Is that beer can supposed to be a banana peel from a kart racing game?!!
Ahahahahah!

104011.t: Humanitas Alley
Ah, jeez, my butt hurts...

Is she really drunk?
Her throwing angle is incredibly precise!!
She's clearly done this more than once or twice!
Though it didn't feel like she was trying to harm ...
If I recall, the last time we encountered her was when we had breakfast in the cafeteria before our release. Is that correct?

That's right.
For some reason, it seemed like she was brought in early this morning.
and she seemed to be talking about something, but I was too focused on the food to listen.
Hmm, she didn't say anything special...
I think we only told her about our previous prison break and a few of our recent jobs.
Surely she didn't blow up the side of the Panoticon just because of our prison break story, right...?
...By the way, where could she have taken our leader?

Even if he is physically weak and not of the slightest help with bread tasting,
he is still the leader of M.A.D., so I hope she does not treat him too harshly.
When someone is kidnapped, we should go to the police first, right...?
...Ugh, but I'm not sure how much help the police will actually be.
Or maybe we could ask the people who have helped us with our previous requests for cooperation...

Did you get their personal contact information?
It seems only  properly shared their number.
Ah...
F-For now, let's just ask whoever is nearby to help us!
Y-Yes, let's do that.
Ahaha! What is it you want help with?
By any chance, is it to teach a lesson to the jerk who caused this mess?!
If that's the case, I'll help as much as you want!!
M-Maybe we should listen to their story first...

Talk later!
Revenge comes first!! Tofu Troupe crewThe Great Tofu Troupe

Oh, it's The Great Tofu Troupe!!
I was just wondering how to get in touch with you guys anyway.
If it's the Tofu Troupe, we can certainly trust them.
I must at least acknowledge their ability to take action.
However, finding our leader takes priority over revenge.

What,  got kidnapped?
No wonder he wasn't with you guys.
Tracking and rescue aren't exactly our specialties though.
Hmm...

Oh?
Suji, you look like you're really troubled by something...

Th-There is one way, but...
it's a little... complicated in more ways than one...

Huh?
What's so awkward about it?

N-No, it's just...
My master could help, but I feel like things might get pretty complicated afterward...
Come on, what's the worst that could happen?
I mean, she's Suji's master. I'm sure it'll be fine, whatever happens!

Umm...
O-Okay, I understand.

Since... 's safety is at stake...
I should be willing to deal with at least this much... right?!

Huh?
S-Suji?
Why are you running toward Panoticon?

Wh-What is going on?
Should we follow her??

...For now, it seems we have no other choice.
Booster on.
P-Please wait!

Ahaha☆
You're going to see that person, aren't you?

She's bizarre in many ways...
but she's definitely helpful.

Hmph.
Though I don't think she's ever been that helpful with our tofu sales.
That's because your sales tactics are terrible!!
That's because your marketing is garbage!!

Are you done talking?
Let's throw down!!

Oh, bring it on!
Today we're settling this once and for all!!

Ahaha☆
What a mess again!
You got this, Suji!

104020.t: Thud—!
Ouch... Put me down a little more gently!

Ehehehe...
No can do!

Right now, I... *Hic*...
can't really control my strength, ya see!

Sigh...
So, where is this?
Don't tell me you actually own property in Humanitas...

No way, it's nothin' like that...
More like a lodging I "borrowed" for a bit...
Just what kind of sucker did you rip off?

Rip off?!
No using such nasty words!

We Unsigned...
only rob bad guys...!

...Or guys who stiffed us on money...
Hehehe...

Hey, what was that silence just now?
It's making me anxious.
Oh, but hey, Fixer...
Aren't you... thirsty...?

Huh??
All of a sudden?
There was some reeeally strong liquor in the Head Maid's room...
I wanted to try it so badly... so I borrowed some...
Hehehehe... but it's too good to drink alone...
They say these things are best shared, don't they...?

I-I'll pass.
If it's that strong, it's basically pure alcohol—

Come on, no way!
Here, bottoms up!
Argh, get away from me,  you drunkard!!!
...This conversation is going nowhere. ???
Captain Mane, time out. ???

Ptooey, ptooey!!
What is this?!
Ugh... that instantly sobered me up...
What else? It's coffee-scented spray. ???
It's very effective when you need to sober up. What do you think? ???
Ugh, maybe for a coffee addict like you. Ptooey...
Of all things, why did you have to spray it directly into my mouth?
Because it's effective and efficient? ???
Want me to spray it up your nose next time? ???

Jeez, no thanks.
I'd better go to the bathroom and rinse my mouth out. Ugh...
...Who are you supposed to be?

...Nice to meet you, Fixer. My name is Oblia.
I'm one of Mane's companions.

I asked Mane to put me in touch with you because I needed some help...
but I didn't expect us to meet like this.
Kidnapping someone just because you need help is certainly a new approach.
Actually, now that I think about it, maybe not...
Anyway, so what kind of help do you need?
Hmm... before we get into the job, let me ask you a few things.
Don't feel pressured, just think of it as a pre-interview.

An interview...
Don't you think that's a bit funny given that I've been kidnapped?
You go in and out of Panoticon pretty often, so are you the type who doesn't mind doing illegal work?

Are you just ignoring my question?!
Sigh...
...It's not like I go around committing crimes just because I want to do bad things.
Though it's true I needed quick cash because I blew through all the money I made recently.
So you sometimes turn to crime to make ends meet?
Well, does petty revenge against a casino that cheated me out of my money count as that...?
So you're just petty.
Hey. That's not a very nice way to put it.

Hmm...
Well, to put it nicely, you're no hardened criminal.
Exactly. It's not like I'm some bread maniac who steals bread every day under the guise of "sampling."
And that's why you ended up in Panoticon recently?
I just ended up there because I was trying to help some actual desperate thieves trapped in a vault.
In exchange for a cut of the credits in the vault?
Ugh...
Essentially, you'll do almost anything if money is involved...

I also heard you're an exhibitionist who roams the streets naked...
Don't tell me you got paid for that too...?
No, I'm not!!!

Hmm, so that information was incorrect...
Fine.
In that case, we can talk about the job now.

...The reward is guaranteed, right?
Even if you kidnapped me, if you don't pay up...

We have plenty of money.
Captain Mane makes pretty good money, despite appearances.
I know all too well that drunkard always finds a way to get paid.
So what's this job that needs so much buildup?
...Smuggle someone out.

Out of Humanitas.
All the way to Vermont.

...Smuggle?
Who? And why?

Me.
For various reasons.
Are you saying you can't explain why?
Or is it just hard to explain?

...Both.
I'll explain later if necessary.
...Well, as long as I get paid, that doesn't really matter much.
So, what do I need to do?
Let's get moving.
We need a few more people to help.

104021.t: Panoticon Secret Passage

You didn't really need to follow me...
It-It's dark, so please be careful...
We're doing this to find Big Boss anyway, so we need to know what's going on!
...By the way, where is this?
Th-This is a secret passage leading to the security zone deep inside Panoticon.

We were told never to use this route unless it was an emergency, but...
the entrance is a mess, and the s-situation is what it is...

Hmm... really?
This place reeks of something illegal!
A-Anyway, it's dark, so please don't push and move slowly...
Whoa, something touched my butt!!

Wh-What is it?! What gives?!
Why do you keep poking me!

Ah, that's probably the tip of my staff.
It's so dark that I've been feeling my way around with it to avoid bumping into anything...
Freya, your butt is so soft and firm...

Ah, well...
Thanks...?

Ow!!
Why are you poking me again?!
...? I didn't do anything this time...
C-Come to think of it, I think I saw a rat in this passageway before...

E-Eeeek???
L-Let's get out of here, fast!!!
W-Wait, there's a ledge here—

Huh? What did you—
Gack!!!
Someone's Hideout

Oww...
That's why I said there was a ledge...
Ugh, I just wanted to get out fast. I didn't think we'd end up like this...

S-So, where are we...?
It's still a bit dark, but... did Panoticon always have a room like this...?
Normally, the maids manage everything, so it shouldn't be this messy...
...At least the desk area is clean.
It doesn't look like it's been vacant for long. It seems more like the room of someone who's simply bad at keeping things tidy.
Whoa, they just tossed their underwear right here.

Look how big these are.
They might be about Lumina's size...?

Oh, really?
I wonder if they're designer underwear.

Wow, these are expensive too, aren't they?
Such high-quality material... Huh?
Is there a problem, Lumina?

O-Oh?
These... are knockoffs?
You can tell just by looking at it once...?
Of course! I've looked through more than my fair share of designer catalogs!
Well, well. My apprentice brought some unusual friends again. ???
Wh-Who's there?

Who else?
I'm the owner of this room. ???

Nice to meet you. I'm Bobcat.
Some call me... the Demon of Panoticon.

I've never heard of that.
Are you actually known by that alias, or is it just an edgy persona?

Hello, M.A.D.
I've met your leader before... but this is my first time meeting the rest of you.

...?
You've met the Big Boss?

Through Suji, that is.
Hehe... He was quite interesting. Interesting enough to make me want him for myself.

Just kidding, just kidding.
Anyway...

Once again, welcome.
As the sole long-term inmate of this prison-slash-hotel, and as the shadow of this street... I welcome you.

...?
Is there even such a thing as long-term imprisonment?

Officially, no.
Let's just say I have my reasons.

Anyway, my dear apprentice?
What brings you to me today?
I thought you were determined to avoid asking for my help unless it was absolutely necessary?

U-Um, we need some information.
The culprit who blew up Panoticon's outer wall and kidnapped ...

Ah, that mercenary?
If you're talking about Mane, I already know all about it.
The Head Maid was sighing and looking for a repair company just a moment ago.

Oh my?
That's a much calmer reaction than expected!
Ever since you broke out, barged back in, and trashed the place, she barely bats an eye at anything anymore.

...And keep this a secret, but I made a killing again.
That's why she's letting this one slide more easily.
What did you short this time...?
Panoticon.

I didn't know Panoticon had stocks.
Isn't this outright market manipulation?

Now, now, this is just a healthy correction.
I had absolutely no idea someone would plant bombs on their way out!
...So you knew.
You knew.
You knew.

They've grown too much lately.
It was simply time to knock them down a peg.
Push what down? Whose head?

Push down on a head...?
Maybe if it were breasts...

She is talking about stocks.
That has nothing to do with pushing someone's head down.
I don't understand a single thing you guys are saying...
M-Me neither...
Well, that's not important, so let's move past it.
So, you're looking for that mercenary, right?

Y-Yes.
Since you have so many informants, Master...
For free?

Hey now, my apprentice.
I'm a businesswoman, too.

Speculation... I mean, investing is one of my trades,
but so is the underworld of this street.
Even if you're my apprentice, I can't keep helping you for free.

A-Ahahaha...
W-Well, what do you need then...?
Fufufu... Yes, that's more like a businessperson.
Now, shall we talk business?

104030.t: Humanitas Alley
So, where are we going now?
Ah, there are some allies I work with often!
If nothing else, they're great at opening anything that's locked.
Why do we need that for smuggling?
Because the actual smuggling is the final phase of this operation.

We have quite a lot to do before that.
And a lot of things we need, too.
We have a lot to do before that. And a lot of things we need.
Isn't this a total scam—
Of course. I'll treat each task as a separate job and pay you for each one.

On top of that, you'll get a hefty bonus once everything's done.
What do you say?
Just give me the word, boss!!

You don't have to call me boss.
It's a bit too much...
Anyway, we're here. This is the place.
Super Rich Hideout

Huh??
What are you doing here, ...?

Why are you here?
Did you quit being a Fixer and decide to become a mercenary?

No way.
I'm just a hired hand here, too.

More importantly, weren't you guys working part-time loading and unloading delivery trucks?
Why are you all just hanging around here?
N-No way!
It's just our day off, ahahaha...

Yeah, right. Knowing the Hardworking Boss,
she'd put you on shifts before she'd ever give you all the same day off!

This is a hundred percent slacking off, isn't it?
I should send a MochiTalk to Charlotte later and tell her to drag you back—
It is not slacking off, it is power-saving mode.
It was simply a conscious choice to secure adequate rest.
Wow, this shamelessness is totally on Theta's level.
I do not know who that is, but I shall take it as a compliment!

...These guys are the lockpicks?
I'm not exactly convinced.

Hey!!
"Lockpicks"?! Seriously?!
Do we look like toothpicks to you?!
Yeah, yeah. Says the lousy thief who can crack a vault but can't even get out of one.
Urgh, seriously...

Sometimes those raiders steal stuff and lock it away in special vaults.
Even shooting them won't open them.
But the Super Rich always get the job done, so I keep coming back to them.
We're desperate too. You're one of our few steady sources of income.
So don't go around saying things that ruin our reputation.
Alright, alright.

But... special vaults?
Why are people in this world so obsessed with vaults anyway?

I don't know!
But there are a lot of thieves around, after all.
I heard there's even a vault designed to humiliate anyone who forces it open. It sucks you in headfirst and leaves only your butt sticking out.
You mean the one that sends everything from your head to your waist into another space, making it look like you're sticking out of a wall?

Ah, yeah!
Exactly, that's the one.

Damn...
My professor developed that one...
I'm seriously interested. Introduce me to your professor.
Let's talk business first.

I'm Oblia, a member of the Unsigned, like Captain Mane.
I'd like to officially hire Super Rich for this job.
You didn't bring a vault, so I guess this is different from your usual jobs?
I don't know whether it'll be a vault or another security system, but I expect we'll need your help.

If it's something we can steal and bring back, we'll bring it here...
Otherwise, we may need you to come to us.

I get it for now.
So, what's the pay?
All the Credits we plunder during this job...
Of course, if there are no Credits, I'll pay you separately.
...So the target is something other than money.

Correct.
This time, the target isn't money or an object. It's data.
If left alone, it could cause massive problems, so we must retrieve or destroy it quickly.
But why do you guys have to be the ones to find it?

It's not like the Unsigned are champions of justice,
and you don't exactly have an obligation to prevent problems from happening.
...First of all, we haven't fully identified what the data is yet.
But there's a good chance it's a collection of confidential information that could bring down most companies in Humanitas.
Someone could probably use it to blackmail each company for a fortune.

Like some company CEO's secret paid-subscription photo collection
or something?
Well, there could be something like that in there.
Great, then let's go add it to my collection—I mean, retrieve it...
The issue is that not only the data, but the malware used to harvest it might also still remain.
If that spreads too, it could cause far more damage than just bringing down a few companies.
At worst, Humanitas's entire economic and financial system could collapse...
...At that point, it's not a secret scandal, it's a doomsday button.

...And that code.
There's a good chance it's a variation or copy of code I wrote a few years ago.

The AI source code that caused the Worst Morning...
Yeah, I wrote that.

...What on earth is the Worst Morning?
Did everyone just wake up with terrible bedhead or something...?
...You really don't know anything, do you?

Of course I don't.
I haven't even been in Humanitas that long.

Explain it to me.
Three lines, please.

Sigh... I don't know about three lines, but this happened a few years ago.
There was a company developing an AI assistant.

That AI was seriously impressive.
It specialized in finding and organizing exactly the information you needed.
Even I benefited from it when writing my university reports...

A-Anyway.
The problem arose after that...

I'd been pulling all-nighters for days working on the AI...
Then one night, I was so exhausted that I fell asleep, and that's when it happened.

The next morning, almost every company in Humanitas had its confidential information stolen.
By the AI I'd developed.
By confidential information, you mean...
Account information, contracts, passwords, even stored customer data. Everything.

I heard only a few companies, including Midwen Corporation, managed to stay secure by cutting the power
or constantly putting up new firewalls...
After that, inevitably, countless companies went bankrupt, and many people suffered.
Wow... that is way more serious than I thought.
Just what kind of monster AI did you create??

...I don't know.
I certainly didn't develop it to behave like that.

I suspect something happened while I was asleep, but...
with no evidence and no one to help me, I fled.

The company I worked for took the blame and went under...
And now I'm wanted, so I can only enter or leave Humanitas illegally.
Still, before I ran, I took only my AI's core source code and destroyed all the rest, or so I thought...
Recently, I heard that someone was distributing my old prototype source code on data drives.
A message? From whom?

I don't know...
I have no idea how they got my contact information, which has me worried.

But they seemed to know me surprisingly well...
And they showed me proof I couldn't deny.

...Okay, I understand that there's a dangerous prototype out there.
So, what do we need to do?
About that...
First, I need you to take off your clothes.
...What?

104040.t: Humanitas Alley
Aw, man... I got my hopes up for nothing when you told me to strip.

Got your hopes up? For what?
Is your exhibitionism acting up again?
How many times do I have to tell you? I'm not an exhibitionist.
More importantly, why are just the two of us going? And why did you soak my clothes?
The prerequisites are a small group and the clothes we soaked in that scent earlier.

Don't worry.
It's all according to plan.
Hey, don't leave me out.
I'm on standby for ranged support, so it's not like I didn't come along.

Tch...
Would've been nice if everyone else had stripped too.
You made me walk around awkwardly covering myself with a towel for ages.
It's all part of the plan, so please just bear with it for a bit.

But you haven't told me anything about this plan or operation.
Don't tell me—
...A chemical that suddenly melts clothes?!
...A magic potion that suddenly makes clothes disappear?!
You don't... actually have some exhibitionist streak, do you?

I said I don't!!
At this point, it feels like you just want to see my naked body!

Hmm...
Well, by my standards, you weren't exactly bad to look at.

...Really?
Which parts?

Come to think of it, I can't quite remember what made me feel that way.
It's like my memory's a little hazy...

Strange. This might be similar to perception-disrupting technology...
And yet, I'm certain you smell nice...
What did you say?

Huh?
Nothing.
Hmm, I'm pretty sure you said something...
Huh? I didn't hear anything either.

Sigh...
I suddenly miss the M.A.D. crew.
At least their antics are somewhat predictable.
Speaking of antics, you're no slouch yourself, Fixer.
I heard you were quite a handful from the moment you arrived in this city!
...It was totally out of my control, okay?!
I don't know if my clothes got entirely burnt off while I was falling from the sky, but there was nothing I could do about it!
Hmm... Even someone exceptionally sturdy should've needed at least a day to recover in Saverim after a fall like that.

Are you sturdier than you look?
Or do you have some sort of special ability...?

Well, I don't know either.
Maybe a god helped me or something.

Could it be, ...
Are you a follower of Harmonix?

No, why?
I mean, sure, I did grab a cookie from some nuns preaching on the street, but...
I don't really care about religion, so calling me a follower would be a bit of a stretch.
(And honestly, even with the goddess in my Quartz, or the blonde goddess who slapped me, I don't really know anything about actual faith.)

...By the way, Oblia.
I have a question, too.
Hm? What is it?

If you're wanted, do you really have to stay on the run?
Can't you just spend a day in Panoticon and leave?
...Being wanted isn't the real problem. I've made too many enemies.

Imagine someone with no real combat ability getting caught by all the people who lost money because of me.
What do you think would happen?

...Ah. I get it.
Yeah, that's reason enough to stay on the run.

Then why did you agree to meet me in person?
I could have caught you.

...You haven't been in this city for very long, right, Fixer?
It's not like you lost money because of the Worst Morning.
And as long as there's money you can make right now, you wouldn't have any reason to betray me.
...You're absolutely right, so I can't even argue with that.

Right, anyway... why aren't you telling me the plan?
Are you going to make me strip in the middle of the street again?
There's no point explaining everything step by step when you'll find out soon enough.

Ah, here they come.
Our next partners.
Hehehe, look at these folks. They look like they've got some serious cash!
Come on, let's see what's in those Credit pockets!

Let's deal with this quickly and get out.
Our girls can't keep watch forever.

Y-You're right.
Sorry, I lost my cool for a moment...
For now, what I can do is...
I cut the power, so the cooling system will stop soon.
Once that happens, all the servers here will be damaged, and the data on them will be lost.
And that solves the problem?
It's not a perfect solution, but...
Not ideal, but I guess we don't have another option, right?
Then let's get out of here quick.

O-Oh? Wait...
In this corner...
What did you do with that USB drive we found and gave you last time?
Huh? That? I still have it. Why?
W-Well, there's a bunch of drives that look exactly the same over in this corner...
What on earth is this...
...I'll have to check this later in a secure environment.

, give me your drive too.
I'll check if it's safe.
Th-That might be a bit of a problem.
You know, privacy, personal freedom, and all that stuff...
It's dangerous.
I said it's dangerous.
It's really dangerous, you know??
Ugh, alright, alright! I get it!!
I'll give it to you later, so let's get out before it burns down!!

104110.t: Humanitas Alley
...I knew they were drawing attention outside, but I didn't expect it to be this extreme.
Honestly, at this point, it's not drawing attention, it's just a straight-up war—
Ah, !!

Looks like the kidnapping got sorted out.
We were all really worried!
Well, as you can see, I'm perfectly fine.
Th-That's a relief...
...But anyway, if that's the case, we didn't even need to come all this way, did we?
Suji insisted we come help, so we even set up a temporary shop nearby to keep an eye on things!
, Suji even brought all kinds of medicine in case you were hurt or in danger!

V-Victoria!
You didn't have to tell them that...!!
Ahaha☆

What's this?
You guys are more loyal than I thought.
Unlike a certain someone.
I agree.
I-I said I'm sorry...
Fufu, I'm only teasing.
Honestly, when they said they'd shove that tail in, even I got chills.
...Lumina, I bet your shivers were for a completely different reason.
Ahhn... ♡
Anyway, everyone is safe, so don't worry.
We got what we came for, so if we just go back like this—

Sorry, but that's not happening!
These guys spat on our tofu.
They actually spat on our tofu, asking who gave us permission to do business here!
...Okay, they definitely need a lesson.

Right!
So I'm going to give them a thorough beating☆

Let's go, Suji!
Let's teach them a lesson!!!
Y-Yeah...!!

...So it really is a war.
Well, I'm sure they'll handle it.
Maybe we should slip away...
Who the hell is messing with my girls?!

How dare you start a fight while I was briefly away on business?!
I'm going to beat you all to a pulp and rob you blind—
Ahahahahaha!!!
Gyaaa!!!

Hey!
What the hell are you doing while someone is talking?!
You didn't think everyone gets to have a cool entrance scene, did you?

Know your place, you third-rate thug!
Get lost!!
Kyaaa!!!

Wow, I wondered what kind of boss it would be this time...
Turns out she's a total pushover.
W-Who are you calling a weakling—
Gyah!!!!
Don't compare some lousy back-alley thug to a wasteland outlaw!
You're done with your business, right?
Yeah. Our job here is done for now.
The problem is, we have no way of knowing how far the modified prototype code has been distributed...
Well, I've got a way to handle that.
We just need to make one of them talk, right?
U-Ugh...
I-I am the ruler of these back alleys, Godmo—
I don't care about your name.
I know, I know.
Every criminal has a story, right?
But I don't really care about some villain's sob story...
What nonsense are you talking about? I didn't even say—
Gyaaaah—!!
I'm sure you had things you wanted to do, and a time when you didn't want to get involved in this shady business...
But hey, why should I care?
Wh-What have you been talking about—
H-Haaah—!!!
The only thing that matters is that you have the info I need...
And since that's all I care about, spill it before I tickle you some more.
Otherwise, the suffering will only last longer.

H-Humph!! You think I'd give in to that?
I am God—
Gyah!!!
Y-You're impossible to talk to, you jerk—
Ahaha☆ Where do you think you're going?!
Aaagh!!!
Hehehe, thugs like her really only learn after a good beating, don't they?
Ugh...!
I'll tickle you for what your lackeys tried to do to me with that tail!!
Oh, that sounds fun, but how about we shove another tail inside her instead?
Uh, that's a bit much...
Tch.

...???
What does that even mean—
Aaaahhhh!!!

104120.t: The next morning.
M.A.D. Hideout
What's up with her?

Hehe, it's nothing.
She just saw something she shouldn't have.

...?
I don't know what she saw, but...
Anyway, how's the work going?
*Sigh*... The drives were all encrypted, so they gave me some trouble, but...
As expected, both the Fixer's drive and the data drives from the secret vault contained copies of the prototype code.

For some reason, though, all the code was inactive.
That made it easy to deal with.

Anyway, um...
There was also a lot of... skin-colored data on the Fixer's drive...
Ah, so that's why Caren...
What about my privacy?
Well, if your privacy matters more than losing what little money you have left and all your personal information.

Also, I recommend formatting every device you've plugged that drive into.
There's no telling how far the copied code may have spread.

That's...
*Sigh*... I guess there's no helping it.
So, was the info you squeezed out of Godmother actually useful?
Not as much as I hoped. She said she was hired by someone named L to copy a bunch of server data onto those drives.
Other than that they used dead drops—copying the data onto drives, leaving them at designated locations, and having someone else pick them up—I didn't get much out of her.
What about the data center itself?
She said she knew nothing about it. She'd just received the old mansion as an advance payment.
Though we might find something if we do a proper investigation on its ownership.
I see...
So they basically gave them a hideout and all that unusual tech in exchange for doing their dirty work.

Anyone capable of moving that kind of capital must be extremely wealthy or someone high up...
But we still don't have enough information.
Why would someone like that do something like this?
I don't know either, but...
This modified prototype code can train itself with AI to bypass even firewalls and antivirus software on its own, at speeds no human can match.
I suspect they might be trying to take over Humanitas with this.
Wait, what? That's terrifying.
If things go really wrong, an even bigger incident than last time could happen.

Not just something like the Worst Morning...
A much bigger catastrophe could occur.

A literal blackout.
The entire city will grind to a halt.
...And here I was, worried we'd get our power cut because we can't afford the electric bill.
Great, we'll save some money then.
...This really isn't something you should be joking about.
When someone is trying to have a serious conversation—

...Hey.
Sorry to cut you off, but...
Putting jokes aside, what can we actually do to help?

No, I mean... don't worry too much.
The city didn't end up ruined during the Worst Morning either, did it?
What do you mean...?
...I'm saying we'll find a way.
We don't know how far the drives have spread, we don't know who's behind it, and we can't exactly go public with this...

But you know, you developed that AI, right?
Then shouldn't you be more than capable of stopping it?
Th-That's...

Just build a new AI.
Write some new code that can block that old one.

I mean, you're literally the only one who can do it.
So you have to.
...That's easier said than—
Of course it's not easy.

But think about it. You're a wanted fugitive who snuck into Humanitas
and even hired a Fixer you barely knew to do all this—

Doesn't that mean you still have lingering...
well, affection for this city?

...Affection?
Me...?
You wouldn't be trying so hard to fix this if you didn't care.
I mean, a mercenary acting on a tip rather than an official contract speaks for itself.
That's...

...Ah, is "affection" the right word?
Responsibility? Or maybe guilt...?
Damn it, trying to say something nice for once really isn't like me...!
Anyway, you did nothing wrong.
You were just pulling an all-nighter and fell asleep, and then the AI went rogue on its own the next day, right?
Someone else might have messed with your code, so stop carrying this burden all by yourself.
...That's a bit too much of a leap...
Ugh, now that I think about it, this pisses me off!
It's not like you caused the Worst Morning on purpose, so why are you wanted?

Hey, believe it or not, I actually know Midwen.
I can introduce you to her, so you can get a powerful backer—
...Pfft.
...Ahaha, hahahaha...!!
...Huh? Wait.

...W-What's so funny?
Why are you laughing?

Oh, no, it's just...
I feel like something that's been weighing on me for a long time suddenly lifted...
Ahahaha... Whew...
...I-Is that so?
Thanks for getting angry for me... even though it wasn't your problem.
I really mean it, Fixer.
Sigh... I just got heated and blurted out whatever came to mind...

It's embarrassing, so please forget it.
Alright?
Hehe... I'll think about it.
Tch...
Uh, anyway... did you find out who tipped you off about this code being distributed?
...No, not yet.

They seem to have quite a bit of influence...
But I couldn't find any way to trace them.
Hmm...
(I have someone in mind... but since I'm not sure yet, it's probably best to keep it to myself for now...)
... Fixer?

Oh, it's nothing.
I was just thinking.
Well, if you say so.

Anyway, thanks for your help this time.
I've sent your payment, so I should get going too.
Wait, what about smuggling you out? Isn't the request still active?
Let's cancel that for now.
After hearing what you said, I thought of a slightly more efficient way.

Is that so?
Well, it's up to the client.

Yep, it's my call.
So...
Let's work together again soon, Fixer.

U-Uh, yeah.
Sure, whatever...
Now, finally, we should divide up the loot.
Can I take a few of the lenses we took from Godmother?
Well, they're single-use, but since we have ten of them, sure, go ahead.
Just leave half of them for me to play with later.
What are you going to use them for?
That's a secret.
Well, obviously you're planning to peek at people naked.
Are you in my head? What, is being a pervert my true nature or something?
Isn't it? Want to test it?
Is this... defective?
Huh? What do you mean, defective?

Ah, never mind.
I think I just saw something weird for a second.

I thought I saw a massive flash of blue light...
Right after that, the lens fried.
Ah—
Ahem... Well, these things happen.

...?
Are you hiding something?
No way.
Hmm... suspicious.
Let me take a closer look.
After all, to properly observe someone...
You have to get close, and commit their appearance, and their scent to memory...
...isn't that how it's done?
Hey? Whoa, you're too cl— Mmph!!
